title: The picomatch patch test builds its workspace-line RegExp from fully escaped names, and the SaaS contract generator strips script tags in any case until none is left
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout after pnpm install, run run.cmd (no database, no network).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The root and theme pnpm-workspace.yaml lines for both picomatch patches are matched with every RegExp metacharacter of the name escaped, backslash included.
build-qa-contract-kinetic.mjs removes <script ...>...</script> regardless of case and repeats until stable, keeping <scripted> and <script-widget>.

selectors.generator: packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-saas/tools/html-text.mjs withoutScripts escapeRe, used by build-qa-contract-kinetic.mjs htmlOf and menuLabel

fence: Literal strings placed into a RegExp go through escapeRe; script stripping is case-insensitive and loops to a fixed point

tests: each EmDash theme carries the root patch files and names them in patchedDependencies
withoutScripts removes script elements in any case, including one split by a removal
withoutScripts keeps elements whose name only starts with script
